tagline: Mughal monuments, street food and modern museums in India's capital
signatureFood: butter chicken, chole bhature, parathas, kebabs, daulat ki chaat

seasons.label: Cool season
seasons.note: Best weather for monuments; Nov-Jan can bring fog and heavy air pollution.

seasons.label: Hot season
seasons.note: Very hot; plan monuments early morning and use air-conditioned museums at midday.

seasons.label: Monsoon
seasons.note: Humid with sudden downpours and waterlogging; keep indoor options ready.

places.name: Red Fort
places.desc: 17th-century Mughal fortress-palace and UNESCO site; closed on Mondays.

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.desc: One of India's largest mosques; cover shoulders and legs, and climb a minaret for old-city views.

places.name: Chandni Chowk Food Walk
places.desc: Tasting walk through Delhi's most famous food lanes: paratha gali, jalebi, chaat and kebabs.

places.name: Humayun's Tomb
places.desc: Garden tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal, set in a restored charbagh garden.

places.name: India Gate and Kartavya Path
places.desc: War memorial and landscaped ceremonial boulevard that is lit up beautifully after dark.

places.name: Qutub Minar Complex
places.desc: 73 m victory tower from 1199 with an iron pillar and early Islamic ruins in the surrounding complex.

places.name: Lotus Temple
places.desc: Baha'i house of worship shaped like a lotus, with a quiet meditation hall; closed on Mondays.

places.name: Akshardham Temple and Exhibitions
places.desc: Huge carved-stone temple complex with exhibitions and an evening water show; no phones or cameras inside.

places.name: National Museum
places.desc: Large museum of Indian art and archaeology from the Harappan era to modern times; a good midday indoor option.

places.name: Hauz Khas Village and Ruins
places.desc: 14th-century madrasa ruins by a lake, surrounded by hip cafes, bars and boutiques.

places.name: Dilli Haat Crafts Bazaar
places.desc: Open-air crafts bazaar with artisan stalls and a food court serving dishes from different Indian states.

places.name: Sunder Nursery
places.desc: Restored heritage park with Mughal-era tombs, landscaped gardens and bird-watching.
